classification: v1 comparison evidence, not a second candidate

metrics_spec.classification: all thresholds are prospective design assumptions; all records synthetic

grain.support: one person × due-assignment quarter; unique case-root
grain.backoffice: one person × due-assignment quarter; unique operation-root
grain.project: one team × assigned-quarter × root deliverable; personal exposure/one fixed annual window separately

metrics_spec.formula: cohort=all independently assigned unique roots due by end of quarter, including unresolved/reopened/late; support numerator=accepted resolved nonrepeat roots, backoffice numerator=accepted in-SLA nonreturned roots, project numerator=accepted released used matured root obligations. value=numerator/all_due_roots; normal>=0.95, stretch=1.00. No worklog or available-hours denominator; no complexity weights in outcome fraction.

project_contract.due_rule: All root obligations assigned in quarter with pre-quarter criteria are due by quarter end; independent prospective programme contract, not task due_at. This assumption must be announced before effort; open root without project evidence stays in denominator pending.
project_contract.use: At least one observed real workflow run for declared one_internal_process; positive adoption evidence, not monetary benefit or impact_score. Repeated usage_units for parts counted once per deliverable.
project_contract.maturity: 14 days from release to usage observation; observation no later than quality_close. Actual acceptance/release after period end is failed period, distinct from late export of timely proof.

capacity_standard.fixture_status: absent; IT-DEL is task class, not a normative root result
capacity_standard.future_setup: 80 manager+40 IT hours preliminary commissioning included in launch; no fabricated normative values in runtime

quality.compatible: personal/team scope as applicable; defect_penalty,0..100,penalty-v1; independently finalized by quality_close, observation through quality_close, census_of_scenario_work_register. Whole root/case coverage required; same inspection_id is one check; projects must cover all source parts or same_deliverable_inspection.
quality.pass: root-wise worst observed score; average across unique roots>=95, critical=0 and major=0. This is a conservative observed QA gate, not an inference of population quality.
quality.missing: incompatible, other period, wrong scope, unobserved consequences or missing independent acts => pending, not zero; missing before start=>not_computable; lost partition=>source_incident/pending.
quality.CSAT: report eligible/invited/responded and scale separately; no CSAT rank/gate, no blending 97/100 and4/5.
quality.reuse: Only matching criterion+scope+period+inspection+independence reused. No routine new20-case QA of every person; unavailable trait requires separately costed check.

rank.order: inside same registered role/source group, descending ROUND_HALF_UP(value,2); original unrounded value decides normal/stretch. No ranking across families.
rank.ties: All equal rounded values share scheduled slot fractions spanning ranks r..r+k-1 intersect1..4, including all tied units beyond4. No deterministic ID tiebreak payout.
rank.small_n: less than2 registered units => no top. Unqualified/absent slots remain unissued, no renormalization.
rank.team: pool=150R*unique registered people; allocate one team award after ties, multiply predeclared contribution_share, floor final personal R only; shares<=1; unallocated share remains unissued.
rank.missing: If any potentially eligible registered competitor has pending/not_computable source, hold entire group top until resolved. Provisional rank/amount is not approvedU; restored version recomputes original cycle, no windfall from missing rival.

windows.fixed: one preassigned six-month/two-quarter window every12months, personal cohort unchanged on transfer; same G for eligible part-time person; no floating retry
windows.failure: low result/quality fail or insufficient exposure =>0G current window, next fixedannual window; no retrospective new cohort
windows.incidents: late restored proof of timely performance relates to original right/date; U and orders persist, no savings from delay
windows.fixture_mapping: P1/P2 are synthetic calendar quarters. G and quality-close dates are qualification examples only, not verification of actual personal15th-day windows or all nine cohorts. Production requires exact personal-window export; monetary calendar remains inherited.

missing_and_updates.precedence: known insufficient personal exposure=>not_earned; known prestart gap=>not_computable; lost source=>pending; unconfirmed evidence=>pending; norm absent=>not_computable; verified quality fail=>not_earned; below normal=>not_earned; else measured eligibility earned. Posting requires independent signoff.
missing_and_updates.updates: source versions append/recompute same window; no subject/scenario ID conditionals. Prospective metric changes only for unopened periods; appeal independent5+5 workingdays assumption.

signing.recipient_excluded: own source edits, own classifier change, own exception, acceptance, QA, appeal, signature and posting; team members/control chain excluded
signing.alternate: Named alternate is routing information, never a fabricated executed signature; self-edited records remain held until independent replacement verification.
signing.missing_signature: computed eligibility and calculated amount retained, payment held; U only after signed evidence; no signed_at invented for absent records.

refresh.source_import: daily/versioned during window; final source completeness+quality close; quarterly eligibility and top then personal two-quarter ledger
refresh.owner: independent data/quality/process owner; HR validates rights/fund, distinct nonrecipient operator posts; appeal owner separate

metrics_spec.implementation: evaluator.py evaluate(data,spec) is authoritative executable detail; only public reader materializes tables; JSON and docs publish assumptions before evaluation
